Hi — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka.

I was looking at anantaevents.com — 16 years in the game, 5,000+ projects, 300+ happy clients, covering weddings, corporate events, product launches, concerts, and more. The 'Book Now' button on your homepage is the right idea, but it links to a generic anchor — not an actual booking form.

Here's the gap: with 5,000+ projects and 400+ locations covered, you're clearly handling high enquiry volume. But every enquiry goes through phone (+880 1813340400) or email (info@anantabd.net) — no automated qualification, no instant package pricing, no calendar booking for consultations. For a wedding or corporate event, the client wants to know availability and ballpark pricing immediately, not after a 24-hour email reply.

I built an AI event consultant agent that handles WhatsApp/Instagram enquiries 24/7 — it asks what type of event, guest count, preferred dates, and budget range, then provides instant package recommendations and books a consultation with your team. It also sends follow-up reminders to convert warm leads.

Happy to show you a working demo in 15 minutes. No commitment.

Best,
Fahad
